description: Shared cross-lane fixtures for the historian splice sanitizer. Both lanes must map input to expected byte-for-byte. The sanitizer folds every run of the PINNED fold-whitespace set (JS \s — which includes U+FEFF — unioned with U+0085 NEL; enumerated in boundary.rs is_splice_fold_whitespace and the TS [\s\u0085]+ regex; the class names are not the contract, these vectors pin both directions), trims, then defangs builder-owned tokens: turn-marker tokens and the builder-exclusive media placeholder prefix get the defang_char inserted before the colon, builder wrapper tags (canonical set: HISTORIAN_WRAPPER_LITERAL_TAGS + memory categories, historian-wrapper-tags.ts / historian_prompt.rs) get it before the closing angle bracket. Idempotent: already-defanged text is identity. post_compact_vectors run the commit-strip path (compactTextForSummary / compact_text_for_summary, role assistant) and pin the L2 invariant POST-compact: hash removal plus space collapse must not manufacture a raw inline marker. truncate_vectors run the keyArg fold-then-truncate path (truncateArg / truncate_arg, 60-unit cap) and pin the astral-boundary agreement: a character split by the cap is excluded whole on BOTH lanes.
envelope_tokens: see HISTORIAN_WRAPPER_TAGS (canonical constant); new_messages pair exemplified below
